title: padmate runtime state
description: Persisted profile and layer choices. Contains no held keys or timers.

lastProfile.description: Last active library profile, or empty when disabled.

lastProfileSet.description: Distinguish an explicitly disabled mapping from a first run with no remembered profile.

devices.description: Layer choices by canonical DeviceKey and profile ID.

joycon2.description: Joy-Con 2 controllers that padmate remembers and connects to without the pairing window. Machine state, written by the daemon.

device.title: Device memory
device.description: Profile-specific layer choices for one device.

profiles.description: Layer memory by library profile ID.

joycon2Controller.title: Remembered Joy-Con 2
joycon2Controller.description: One remembered Joy-Con 2: its Bluetooth address, the serial number from its flash and its side.

addr.description: Bluetooth address, AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF in upper case.

side.description: L for a left Joy-Con, R for a right one.

layers.title: Persistent layers
layers.description: Only base, toggled overlays and cycle positions survive a restart.

toggled.description: Toggled overlays in stack order; excludes held overlays.

cycles.description: Cycle positions by action pointer. The base layer is authoritative after edits.
